figures.caption: IEEE-CIS; GNNs on the main graph. Mean precision curve and ±1 sample-SD band across seeds 42–51, interpolated on 1001 common recall points. The synthetic (recall=0, precision=1) endpoint is removed first; at duplicate recall levels the first reversed point is retained, with constant endpoint extrapolation. Bands are clipped to [0,1]. Legend AP is the mean ± sample SD of the saved per-run AP scores, matching the ten-seed result tables; it is not the integrated mean curve. Each curve uses its validation-selected checkpoint; checkpoint paths and hashes appear in pr_curve_sources.csv.
